# I.TRAXE

> I.TRAXE is India's first women safety keychain with GPS. One press sends your live location by SMS to trusted contacts. No app, no internet, no smartphone needed for the receiver.

- Name: I.TRAXE Safety Keychain
- Price: ₹3,599, one-time purchase, no subscription from us
- Battery: 2500mAh rechargeable, up to 24 hours standby, USB-C charging
- SIM: Any 4G SIM with SMS pack. Airtel, Jio, Vi recommended.
- Delivery and warranty: Confirmed by the team on WhatsApp when you order. Warranty is 6 months.
